units: <cite ref="Pesachim 96a:9">Pes. 96ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Arakhin 13b:7">Arakh. 13ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 49b:9">Men. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>טעון ב׳</he> requires examination (as to physical defects).

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 2:3">Ḥull. II, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Chullin 32a:16">32ᵃ</cite>) <he>כדי ב׳</he> as much time as the examination (of the slaughtering knife) requires; ib. 9ᵃ; [ib. 32ᵃ <he>ביקרו של חכם</he>, read <he>ביקור חכם</he> or <he>בִּיקּוּרוֹ של</he>].

<cite ref="Keritot 11a:21">Kerith. 11ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="B01147"><he>בִּקֹּרֶת</he></cite> <cite ref="Leviticus 19:20">Lev. XIX, 20</cite>) <he>בב׳ תהיה</he> she must first be examined (whether she can endure the punishment required by law).
<cite ref="Nedarim 39b:15">Ned. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ חולים אין וכ׳</he> the duty of visiting the sick knows no limits (of time or rank).
